name: hk-islands-facts
description: Small public suite for the trajectory demo: each question needs a search lookup and/or arithmetic, so a tool-using agent has a real journey to record.

tests.prompt: What is the total population of Hong Kong Island and Lantau combined? Use the search tool to find each population, then the calculator tool to sum them.
What is the area of Hong Kong Island, doubled? Find the area with search, then double it with the calculator.
Sum the populations of the three largest Hong Kong islands by area. Use search to find all three populations, then add them with the calculator.
What is 15 percent of the population of Lantau? Find the population with search, then compute 15% with the calculator.
How much larger is Lantau than Hong Kong Island by area? Use search to find both areas, then subtract with the calculator.
What is the average population of Hong Kong Island and Lantau? Use search for both populations, then compute the average with the calculator.
